excerpt.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
excerpt.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In acc

texts.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

tooltips.zh:
暂停[from.GetName]行动，时间为一个月。
我们的成功几率取决于目标的加密等级。
tooltips.en:
Pauses Operation [from.GetName] for about a month.
Our chances of success depend on the target's Encryption level.

tooltips.zh: 暗地里取消这一行动，所有未花费的线人将不会被消耗。
tooltips.en: Silently cancel this operation. Any unspent Assets will not be consumed.

texts.zh:
我们正在观察[luckycatch_country.GetName]的间谍首脑报告了一次新的，令人惊讶的线人获取——一名负责交感神经接触的子个体现在为我们的行动服务。

我们已尽一切努力确保这次新的接触不是一个陷阱。例如，我们现在已经制定了一些协议，以尽量减少该线人为双重间谍的可能性。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster watching over the [luckycatch_country.GetName] reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new Asset - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.

All efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.

texts.zh: 我们在[luckycatch_country.GetName]所进行的诸多隐秘任务就包括低调地搜罗潜在的线人：任何可以帮助我们进一步深入格式塔实体的工具。我们的间谍首脑报告刚刚有了一个幸运的发现。
texts.en: Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the [luckycatch_country.GetName] is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our Spymaster reports having just made one such lucky catch.

texts.zh:
我们成功地让一群[luckycatch_country.GetAdj]敌特落入了我们的罗网。他们似乎正在从事危害我方的行动，但细节尚不清楚。

不过，经由审讯，我们已经搜集到了少许关于[luckycatch_country.GetName]的情报。我方间谍首脑还联系上了一名当地线人以对这些情报进行利用。
texts.en:
We have have trapped a group of [luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.

Through our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Our Spymaster now also has access to a local Asset with which we can press this advantage.

texts.zh:
我们位于[luckycatch_country.GetName]的间谍首脑发来报告，一批敌特业已落网。虽然近日来其对我们的不利行动已不可挽回，但事实证明，对这些人的审讯是有价值的。

我们由此获得的情报的时效并不长，但这些敌特的落网使得我们对抗[luckycatch_country.GetName]的行动取得了一定优势。我们已在这些人中发展了一些线人，以备不时之需。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster in the [luckycatch_country.GetName] reports that we have successfully captured a band of saboteurs. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.

The intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an Asset to aid us when required.

tooltips.zh: 我们已设法在[luckycatch_country.GetName]安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的新线人。
tooltips.en: We have acquired a new Asset for our Spy Network in the [luckycatch_country.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 我们已设法在[luckycatch_country.GetName]安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的新线人。
tooltips.en: We have acquired a new Asset for our Spy Network in the [luckycatch_country.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在[fromfrom.target.GetName]经营而布置好的监视流程。
texts.en: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

texts.zh:
尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在[fromfrom.target.GetName]的特工的通讯。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的加密手段比我们估计的还要高明。

于此同时，[fromfrom.GetName]行动将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。
texts.en:
Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the [fromfrom.target.GetName]. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated Encryption than we had thought.

Meanwhile, Operation [fromfrom.GetName] will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.
